title: A stage agent's result
description: What every stage agent returns, in the unattended workflow (as agent({ schema })) and interactively (checked by a hook): the skill's one-line report as summary, the state script's --brief JSON as data. The workflow carries a copy of properties and required — a test holds the two equal; the conditions under allOf are checked by lib/validate.mjs only.

status.description: continue: the agent checkpointed where model.mjs compact told it to and must be re-run with continue=true (reference/README.md § Context management, rule 7)

question.description: stopped: the exact question for the user

diagnosis.description: error: what went wrong, from the skill or the state script (the error form's error and tried lines)

resume.description: error: the exact invocation that continues from the checkpoint (the error form's resume line)

needs.description: error: what a person must fix or decide first, or "none" (the error form's needs line)

escalate.description: true when the stage proved harder than its rating and should be re-run one tier up (reference/README.md § Models and budget)

data.description: the state JSON as the state script printed it with --brief (id, complexity, next, stopped, closed, unblocked, lock, worktrees, problems)
